# Table

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Lays out rows and cells with column sizing, headers, footers, borders, and pagination.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `BorderedElementBase`. Implements `IRoleProvider`, `IBorderFrameHost`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new Table(...columnWeights: number[])
new Table(options: TableOptions)
```

### `presentation`

```typescript
presentation: boolean
```

When `true`, the table is a **layout (presentation) table**: it arranges content in a grid with no tabular data relationships. Per ISO 14289-1 §7.5 / Matterhorn checkpoint 15, such a table MUST NOT be tagged with table structure — so it is tagged as a generic `Div` grouping and each cell's content is tagged with its own natural role in row-major reading order (no `Table`/`THead`/`TR`/`TH`/`TD`, and `addHeader`/`isHeader` are ignored for tagging). Visual output is unchanged. Default `false` (a semantic data table).

Set this for address blocks, totals boxes, and side-by-side panels; keep it `false` for real tabular data (and mark that data's header cells).

### `rows`

```typescript
readonly rows: readonly TableRow[]
```

*read-only*

The body rows, in order: not the header or footer rows (see `getAllRows`). Add rows with `addRow`.

> A read-only list: read it or loop over it, but it has no `add` or `push`. To add one, call `addRow()`.

### `runningTotalColumn`

```typescript
runningTotalColumn?: number | undefined
```

*optional*

Turns on a running total: the column (0-based, at least 1) that shows it. When the body breaks across pages, each page that continues ends with a "carried forward" row holding the total of the rows' `runningValue` so far, and the next page opens, after any repeated header, with a "brought forward" row holding the same total. The label spans the columns before this one. Both rows are drawn in the footer colours and left out of the accessibility structure, since they repeat what the rows already say. Unset (the default) turns the feature off.

### `runningTotalFormat`

```typescript
runningTotalFormat: string
```

Number format of the running total: `G`, `F<n>`, `N<n>` or `P<n>`, as for charts. Default `'N2'`.

### `runningTotalPrefix`

```typescript
runningTotalPrefix: string
```

Text written before the running total, such as a currency symbol. Default empty.

### `addFooter`

```typescript
addFooter(...elements: Array<IElement | string>): void
addFooter(cells: Array<TableCell | string>): void
addFooter(row: TableRow): void
```

Example:

```typescript
table.addFooter(new TextBlock('Total'), new TextBlock('4'), new TextBlock('£48.00'));
```

### `renderStateful`

```typescript
renderStateful(ctx: RenderContext, width: number): RenderStatus
```

Renders this table with state tracking for pagination. Rows that don't fit on the current page will be continued on the next page. Headers repeat on each continuation page if repeatHeadersOnNewPage is true.

### `resetState`

```typescript
resetState(): void
```

Resets the internal state, preparing the table for a fresh render.
